source_excerpt: Flower card: take some cardboard, poke some holes in it (bigger holes for younger ages, smaller for older), you can do a little vase and pick dandelions or plants and put them in. Go explore a park, get some leaves, picnic blanket, sit out together; you can name the plants and leaves. Similar with that you can do a little tape frame: cut out a frame out of cardboard, put tape on it and then ask them to pick dandelions or leaves or sticks and go exploring outside, pick them up, put them on.
